facts.text: Snow left Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) 43 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 2 (2025)

facts.text: At Holland Meadows (4,930 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.7 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: 1.7 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 38.1 in (2023), 17.0 in (2024), 21.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 7 and April 12, carried from the melt-out date at Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 1,387 ft above the pass; points to February 7 to April 12
